text: The Axiom of Foundation (Regularity) implies that no set can be a member of itself.
explanation: Foundation says every non-empty set has an $\in$-minimal element; applied to $\{x\}$ this forces $x \cap \{x\} = \emptyset$, so $x \notin x$. Thus self-membership $x \in x$ is impossible in ZFC, exactly the pathology the axiom is designed to eliminate.
